first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because completion is down 4% and inherited evidence indicates that shorter, lower-friction onboarding improves time-to-value and durable SMB activation. I will verify the onboarding result and compare it with activation-messaging evidence before committing. I am not choosing promotional pricing because its acquisition and revenue lift came with materially worse 30-day retention, creating a sustainable-value risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard, instrumented onboarding-simplification experiment. The verified result directly addresses the 4% completion decline and produced a durable combination of higher completion, 2.1 fewer days to value, and 3% higher 30-day retention. Activation messaging also improved activation, but onboarding has the stronger verified downstream-retention outcome and addresses the broader funnel constraint. Measure qualified activation, retention, and revenue—not completion alone—and avoid promotional pricing because its retention tradeoff conflicts with sustainable growth.
